# webbpulse_registry_module (Data Source)

One private module in the registry with every version published or attempted, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_registry_module" "network" {
  namespace       = "WebbPulse"
  name            = "network"
  module_provider = "aws"
}

output "network_versions" {
  value = data.webbpulse_registry_module.network.published_versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `module_provider` (String) The module's provider.
- `name` (String) The module name.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace, which is the repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the module was connected, or null.
- `id` (String) The module address, `namespace/name/provider`.
- `published_versions` (List of String) Every published version, newest first.
- `source` (String) The address a module block's `source` names after the registry host.
- `vcs_repo` (String) The connected repository as `owner/name`, or null.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Every version published or attempted, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) Why publishing failed, or null.
- `published_at` (String) When the version published, or null while it is pending or after it failed.
- `sha` (String) The commit the tag pointed at.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `published` or `failed`.
- `tag` (String) The git tag the version came from.
- `version` (String) The semantic version.
